name: Senior move manager

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Family planning call
services.story: A free 30-minute family planning call by phone. Nothing is taken and nothing is owed.

services.name: Remote move plan
services.story: The $150 remote move plan by video, paid in full when booking, with a floor plan after.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Senior move
services.story: The main story: a free assessment; an agreement at $85 an hour per person, estimated 40 to 60 hours, with a $500 retainer; a bill every Friday for that week's hours; the retainer comes off the last bill.

services.name: Senior move
services.story: The same move billed the business's own way, like a check from the older adult's agent under a power of attorney. Rosie sends no bills.

services.name: Downsizing session
services.story: A 3-hour downsizing session for someone staying put, at $85 an hour ($255 minimum); billed after.

services_shape: Project: a free in-home assessment with the older adult and the family, then a written plan and estimate, then a series of sessions (sorting, packing, move day, unpacking) over weeks, billed by the hour every Friday
questions_before_times: Who is moving, and who is asking (the older adult, a family member, a care manager)?
Where from and where to: the town or ZIP of each (a house, an apartment, assisted living, a family member's home)
Any date the move must happen by: a move-in date set by the community, a closing or a lease end
What help is needed: the whole move, sorting only, or setting up the new home
safety_stop: the older adult has fallen and can't get up, is suddenly confused, has chest pain or trouble breathing
a fire, smoke or a gas smell
license: no state license to plan, sort, pack or set up a home in most places, only a business registration; a household goods mover's license (and the state's mover rules) only where the business itself carries belongings in its own truck for pay; otherwise the move is done by a licensed moving company the family hires
messages_never: ["Health, memory or care details, and money details","Door codes and lockbox codes","Why someone is moving: owner and staff texts never say it","Contract papers and lab or medical papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)"]
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
